rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0002, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-9: ONE knob -> per-scan lr 1e-4 -> 2e-4 (2x), at the warm_start=True/ep12/seed42 PEAK base (iter-5 config, SSIM 0.5081 -- NOT the iter-7 seed123 basin, NOT iter-8 warm_start=off). KEEP warm_start=True (LOAD-BEARING-POSITIVE, settled), pretrain_epochs=12 (the init-budget PEAK), seed=42 (the good basin), grad_clip=1.0 (LOAD-BEARING 128-view FBP-adjoint guard, mandatory -- do NOT touch), n_iter=600, val_n=6 (UNCHANGED so SSIM stays iter-to-iter comparable). DIAGNOSIS (numbers, not pixels): the load-bearing-positive warm_start fact is now re-confirmed on demo -- iter-8 warm_start OFF (seed42/ep12) dropped SSIM 0.5081 -> 0.4486 (-0.0595, hr0, PSNR 16.38->16.29), so without the amortized pre-pass each per-scan lr-anchored fit lands in a worse basin. FAILURE MODE = per-image U-Net N2I caps ~0.51 SSIM (hr~0) on this 128-view synthetic-phantom substrate: it is FBP-bounded AND has a large init-driven stochastic noise floor (a seed flip 42->123 alone swung 0.5081->0.4203, -0.088, iter-5 vs iter-7), so single-seed reads are intrinsically noisy here and the U-Net (0.466 M params) overfits one noisy scan where the 6-param bilateral twin physically cannot (twin clears baseline at hr+0.33). LEVER CHOICE: of the genuinely-untried-at-PEAK knobs (pretrain_epochs is EXHAUSTED -- ep12 peak, ep18 worse; grad_clip is LOAD-BEARING/forbidden; val_n change would break iter-to-iter SSIM comparability), do the mild lr RE-CONFIRM the handoff lists: 1e-4 -> 2e-4. lr=1e-4 was picked at iter-3 as the per-scan OVERFIT ANCHOR (1e-3 -> 1e-4 lifted 0.4785 -> 0.4880 by keeping Adam pinned near the warm-start init), but 1e-4 vs 2e-4 was never compared at the converged ep12 PEAK -- only 1e-3 vs 1e-4 at the under-trained ep3 init. So whether 1e-4 is the true per-scan step optimum AT THE PEAK init is untested. HYPOTHESIS: at the ep12/seed42 peak init, a 2x larger per-scan step (2e-4) lets the lr-anchored fit refine slightly further off a now-good warm-start init without descending into the single-scan noise-fitting minimum that killed n_iter (iter-2 1200 steps regressed). If SSIM rises >0.51 then 1e-4 was slightly under-stepping at the converged init (the anchor optimum shifts up once the init is good); if it falls toward ~0.48-0.49 then 1e-4 is confirmed optimal (2e-4 starts to overfit the single scan) and the per-scan anchor axis is settled. Either way DOCUMENTS the per-scan step optimum at the peak init toward the iter-20 ceiling. hr stays ~0 (structurally FBP-bounded on dense-view phantoms). NOTE on the noise floor: any single-iter delta < ~0.01 here is within the demo-n2i seed noise floor and should be read as 'flat', not signal. WALL: warm 12x200=2400 + per-image 6x600=3600 = 6000 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 500 s (iter-5 was 463 s at this exact 6000-step budget), under the 15-min target, the outer_wall_s=1200 guard, and the 00:30:00 (1800 s) sbatch wall -- no need to drop val_n/n_iter. All other knobs IDENTICAL to the iter-5 PEAK config (train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, unet_c=16); ONLY per-scan lr 1e-4 -> 2e-4 changed.
